description: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) targeting Android & iOS: scaffold the shared module, install JDK 17 + Android SDK + the Kotlin/Gradle toolchain, run Gradle test tasks for both targets, and run/debug the Android target. IMPORTANT - iOS LIMITATION: this workbench runs in a Linux container, so iOS build/run/debug (Xcode, the iOS Simulator, xcodebuild) is NOT something it can do - that genuinely requires a macOS host with Xcode installed. Kotlin/Native iOS *test* tasks (e.g. `iosX64Test`) do run here; iOS *build/run/debug* does not. See workbench-setup.sh's own top-of-file comment for the exact boundary.
